stories.headline: Neocloud Lambda secures $1B in debt to buy more chips
stories.dek: Neocloud Lambda has raised $1B in private debt to buy Nvidia AI chips and lease them to Microsoft. It's the latest in a string of loans, underscoring the high cost of the AI boom.
